newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper gains modestly, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper gains modestly, other metals steady.

text.p: Copper gained modestly on Monday on a firm trend on the London Metals Exchange (LME) while other metals were steady in dull trade, dealers said.
Copper rose 25 rupees to 13,675 rupees per quintal in line with rising prices on the LME, dealers said. Copper rose 50 rupees on Friday.

Tin was steady at 31,500 rupees per quintal and so was nickel at 36,500 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,450 rupees per quintal. Zinc was quiet at 7,900 rupees per quintal. Lead was offered at 4,550 rupees per quintal.
